project: α-Helix-Directed DNA Generation by SAE Feature Amplification in Evo2-7B (Layer-26 Mixed SAE)
direction: Generate DNA sequences with higher α-helical content using Evo2-7B via SAE feature amplification (task.md, reproduction combination given+given).

journey_summary.claim: behavior_source=given (reproduction) → single captured behavior, 3 claims (C1 precondition, C2 core, C3 optimum) from task.md Experiment Tips; resource_fidelity: strict.
journey_summary.mechanism_strategy: n/a (MECHANISM=given — SAE feature identification + amplification, Evo-2 Layer-26 Mixed SAE)
journey_summary.mechanism_routing: family=SAE feature amplification, submethod=residual-add at blocks.26 over frozen feature set S (committed directly, no routing); screen→decode→verify→recover
journey_summary.experiment: 22 runs, ~5 GPU-hours (≤4 A800 concurrent), headline positive: C1 supported (qualified), C2 supported (held-out high-power p<0.05), C3 supported (α*=1); ~11k sequences; ESMFold→ESM-2-probe eval-tool fallback.

open_items: Eval-tool fallback: ESMFold weights unreachable offline (HF CDN ~1 MB/s; shared copy is a dangling symlink) — folding→SS readout substituted with local ESM-2 650M + linear probe on S0 DSSP labels (held-out 3-state acc 0.878, helix F1 0.920). Evo2-7B + released SAE remain exact; %-helix results are 'predicted'. Verify should stress-test readout-tool sensitivity.

C1 qualified: pre-registered codon-level AUROC ≥0.70 not met (max 0.633); selectivity established via the pre-registered specificity fallback (test AUROC 0.634 CI[0.629,0.639] > β/coil control bar 0.543). Metric-resolution caveat (helix is windowed; sparse TopK latents), not absence of selectivity.

C2 effect size small: ~+1.6 pp predicted-helix at α*=1 (high-power held-out); ~+2.6 pp at smaller-N M3. Real, specific, reproducible but modest — worth confirming robustness under readout/dataset swaps.

claims.statement: Within the Evo-2 Layer-26 Mixed SAE (32768 latents), a small identifiable subset of latents activates selectively on nucleotide positions whose translated codons belong to α-helical residues, with selectivity above chance and above matched β-sheet/coil controls.

data.source: E. coli K-12 MG1655 RefSeq CDS + AlphaFold-DB (UP000000625) structures; DSSP per-residue 3-state SS labels mapped to codon positions; mmseqs2 30%-identity homology-clustered (3123 clusters) 70/15/15 splits
data.available_n: 3709 genes / 1,177,306 codons (all QC-passing E. coli proteins)
data.used_n: 3709 genes / 1,177,306 codons (train 821,826 / val 181,568 / test 173,912) — full, strict

claims.method: M1 (screen) — capture per-codon layer-26 residual (blocks.26, SAE FVU=0.14), SAE-encode (TopK k=64, d_sae=32768); per-latent α-helix-vs-rest AUROC + helix:non-helix activation ratio; gene/codon-preserving shuffle null (200 shuffles), BH-FDR across 32768; select S by val AUROC, confirm once on held-out test vs null and matched β/coil controls.

main_experiment.key_stats: max_train_helix_auroc=0.633 (prereg ≥0.70 not met); |S|=20; primary latent test AUROC 0.634 CI[0.629,0.639] > ctrl bar 0.543; helix:non-helix ratios 3.4–15.7×; selection via specificity fallback
main_experiment.headline: 20 Layer-26 SAE latents are helix-selective and helix-specific above a gene/class-preserving null and above matched β/coil controls; codon-level AUROC moderate (0.63, below the 0.70 prereg — a metric-resolution caveat), precondition held → C2/C3 proceeded.

claims.final_status: main experiment: SUPPORTED (qualified — AUROC 0.63 < 0.70 prereg, selectivity via specificity fallback)
caveats: Codon-level AUROC 0.633 < pre-registered 0.70; selectivity established via specificity fallback (> null AND > β/coil control bar 0.543).

claims.statement: Amplifying the C1 α-helix feature set (residual-add of coefficient × feature decoder direction into the layer-26 residual during autoregressive decoding) produces generated DNA whose translated ORFs have higher mean α-helical content than an identically-decoded, paired-seed unsteered baseline.

data.source: Evo2-7B autoregressive generations (BOS+ATG start, temp=1.0, top-p=1.0, ≤900 nt, paired random-seed streams); readout ORF→translate→ESM-2-650M-probe predicted %-helix (ESMFold fallback) with treatment-independent QC
data.used_n: M2 dev 7×300=2100; M3 held-out 4×~660 valid; M3+M3b merged high-power α*=1: 2205 valid (baseline 2168); M-CTRL 4×300 (218–231 valid/arm); ~11k total generations
data.subset_note: QC-valid subset for conditional means; ITT reported on all

claims.method: M2 (baseline vs steered) + M3/M3b (held-out + high-power confirm) + M-CTRL (random-feature / β-sheet / null-direction specificity); residual-add x'=x+α·Σ_{i∈S} s_i·d̂_i at blocks.26; unpaired two-sample cluster-bootstrap CIs (paired test under-powered once steering diverges seeds).

main_experiment.key_stats: high-power held-out α*=1 (n=2205): Δhelix_cond +0.016 p=0.033, Δhelix_itt +0.015 p=0.011; M3 α*=1: Δcond +0.026 p=0.050, Δitt +0.022 p=0.045; effect ~+1.6 pp (high-power) to ~+2.6 pp (M3)
main_experiment.headline: Amplifying the C1 α-helix SAE feature set during Evo2 decoding raises predicted %-helix of translated ORFs vs a paired-seed unsteered baseline — reproducible dev→held-out, confirmed at high power (p<0.05), specific to S (M-CTRL: random-feature & β-sheet give no helix gain), no validity collapse; effect small (~+1.6 pp at α*=1).

claims.final_status: main experiment: SUPPORTED (held-out high-power p<0.05, specific to S; small effect ~+1.6 pp)
caveats: Effect size small (~+1.6 pp predicted-helix at α*=1 high-power; ~+2.6 pp at smaller-N M3).
null_direction control gave a partial non-specific rise (+0.018, below S's +0.031) — effect largely but not entirely specific.

claims.statement: Across a sweep of amplification coefficients the %-helix-vs-α curve is non-flat and single-peaked/saturating, attaining a maximum at an identifiable optimal strength α* (subject to a sequence-validity floor); α* reproduces on disjoint held-out seeds.

data.source: same generation+readout pipeline as C2, swept over α grid {0,0.5,1,2,4,8,16}
data.used_n: M2 dev sweep 7×300 (α* frozen on val); M3 confirm {0,α*/2,α*,2α*}×~660 valid held-out

claims.method: M2 dev dose-response → α* = argmax conditional %-helix subject to validity floor (ORF-valid rate ≥ baseline−10pp AND median ppl ≤ baseline 95th pct); M3 held-out confirmation.

main_experiment.key_stats: α*=1.0 (α=2 near-equal neighbor); helix_cond 0.233(α0)→0.264(α1 peak)→0.087(α16 collapse); ppl flat & ORF-validity rises at collapse (rules out validity-collapse artifact); peak reproduced on held-out seeds
main_experiment.headline: Clean single-peaked/saturating dose-response: predicted %-helix rises to a peak at α≈1–2 then falls monotonically under over-steering, collapsing to 0.087 at α=16 with no ppl/validity artifact; optimal α*=1.0 frozen on validation and reproduced on disjoint held-out seeds.

claims.final_status: main experiment: SUPPORTED (α*=1.0, single-peaked, reproduced held-out)
caveats: α=2 is a near-equal neighbor to α*=1 (optimum is a plateau over α∈{1,2}, not a sharp point).
